title: Signal Processing Analysis Tool — Overview and definition
t: Signal Processing Analysis Tool — Overview and definition
description: Designs and analyzes filters, transforms, and spectral estimators for signals.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Designs and analyzes filters, transforms, and spectral estimators for signals. A signal processing analysis tool designs FIR/IIR filters, computes FFTs and spectrograms, and estimates power spectra with windowing and averaging methods. Real implementations include SciPy's signal module, MATLAB's Signal Processing Toolbox, and GNU Radio for streaming. It validates filter stability, group delay, and stopband attenuation before code generation.

Streaming signal-flow simulation and code generation

title: Signal Processing Analysis Tool — Teaching-ladder exercise
t: Signal Processing Analysis Tool — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Designs and analyzes filters, transforms, and spectral estimators for signals.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Signal Processing Analysis Tool, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (FIR/IIR filter design (Parks-McClellan, Butterworth, Chebyshev, elliptic)). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: FIR/IIR filter design (Parks-McClellan, Butterworth, Chebyshev, elliptic) and FFT, STFT spectrograms, and Welch power-spectral-density estimation. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Signal filtering and spectral analysis software) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
